profile.headline: Software Developer Director at G2Apps
profile.summary:
Héctor Sánchez Villeda has over 25 years of experience in all aspects of systems development using Scrum, UML, and Yourdon methodologies.

In terms of application development and support, Héctor has a wide range of experience which includes scientific applications such as LIMS, big data, germplasm bank; financial applications; banking applications; administrative applications; manufacturing requirements planning; He has also fulfilled roles as system production manager, in charge of all of the critical applications systems running in the company as well as computing requirements, hardware, backups, personnel management, and data entry processes working with Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) methodology to ensure daily basis operations. One of the most important scientific system developed at University of Missouri-Columbia in USA was published at: http://www.plantphysiol.org/content/128/1/9.full.pdf At CIMMYT together with the GCP integrated breeding platform team was developed a java project that won the DUKE’s choice award (2014): http://www.oracle.com/us/technologies/java/java-dukes-choice-awards-2312885.pdf

positions.title: Software Developer Director
positions.description:
Primary responsibilities are to provide general strategies about the direction of software development for different projects as well as for the analysis, development, quality check, coordination, standards development, installation and enhancement of new and existing software for  systems in different locations worldwide.
I am developing the G2Alpha it is a lab system which collects clients, materials, quality tests, field information according to standard procedures developed at “Entidad Mexicana de Acreditacion A.C. (EMA)  using smart devices, integrate it to a database, generate queries and report it in standard formats to comply with national and international standards.
I am developing SICAPT system to control technicians working on the wet lab at THOR Quimicos S.A. to keep track the personnel working with biosides, flame retardants, and personal care products. This system will aid with R&D, IVT, and technical service.

positions.title: Crop Informatics Specialist
positions.description:
Primary responsibilities were for the analysis, development, quality check, coordination, standards development, installation and enhancement of new and existing software for crop systems in different experiment stations located worldwide; as well as to provide general strategies about the direction of data capture and data integration.
I developed the FieldLog system which collects trait information using handhelds with Windows Mobile OS, and Fieldfroid using Android operating system for smart devices. I converted the FieldBook system and MaizeFinder system to the International Maize Information System which uses a common Relational Database Management System (MySQL) which collects phenotyipic information and generates statistical analyses, I am developing the Integrated Breeding Fieldbook with Breeding Manager (IBFieldbook); the second release is publically accessible at: https://integratedbreeding.net/ib-tools/field-trial-management/ib-fieldbook. (publication with editors) I also developed the DNATracking system to keep track of Germplasm and DNA samples in the lab for genotyping 96 and 384 well plates, and for individual tubes. During this time I participated in the Fitogenetics Congress in Mexico summary at: http://www.revistafitotecniamexicana.org/documentos/33-4/congreso_somefi.pdf. I worked with SNP marker information coming from the sequencer, using a non relational database hdf5 herarchical structure for storing and data dissemination; I participated in the paper “Genomic selection in wheat using genotyping-by-sequencing” published in plant genome at: http://krex.k-state.edu/dspace/handle/2097/15344.. I worked closely with breeders, technicians and data curators to set up an environment to collect phenotypic information and curate it according to data collection standards.

positions.title: Technical leader for the maize mapping project
positions.description:
Primary responsibilities were for the analysis and development of Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) using Java with Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) and Visual Basic with Object Database Connectivity (ODBC) both working with Sybase accessible at: http://www.maizegdb.org/documentation/maizemap/index.php . I used the Object Protocol Model (OPM) from Gene Logic Inc. developed with Java and Corba allowing distributed database queries. I modified parts of the Genetic Display Tool (GIOT) to make a comparative mapping tool between maize and rice chromosomes. 
I attended the PAG conference in San Diego (January, 2000) where I presented the OPM work, attended the Maize Genetics Conference in Idaho (March, 2000) where I presented posters regarding to LIMS. I attended the Pacific Symposium on Biocomputing in Hawaii (January, 2001). The following year I attended the O’Reilly Bioinformatics Technology Conference in Tucson and the Maize Genetics Conference in Orlando where I presented the iMap (Integrated Genetic and Physical Map) software on-line. I assisted the PAG XI conference in San Diego on January 2003 where I demonstrated the LIMS Scoring Tool for the Maize Mapping Project. My work was published in BioInformatics Magazine at:
http://bioinformatics.oxfordjournals.org/cgi/content/abstract/19/16/2022 .
I developed and programmed the Integration Database System for the Roots Genomics Project using PHP as programming language and ORACLE it is located at: http://genome.rnet.missouri.edu/Roots/Roots_Integration/Query_Info.php
I went to the PAG XVI conference in San Diego in January 2008 where I presented the DNA AlignEditor tool. My work is at BMC Bioinformatics Journal, UK located at: http://www.biomedcentral.com/1471-2105/9/154 .  This software that I have developed is freely available to the community.

positions.title: Project Leader
positions.description:
Primary responsibilities were for the feasibility studies, analysis, development, quality check, coordination, standards development, installation and enhancement of new and existing software systems.
During this time I developed several systems for scientific and accounting areas such as (maize seed inventory system, maize nursery management system, wheat data management system, accounting system for CIMMYT stations) and enhancement of (maize germplasm bank, wheat pedigree management system, payroll system).
I participated with Texas Agricultural Experiment Station (TAES) people in the first International Wheat Information System (IWIS) on CDROM.
I participated with International Rice Research Institute (IRRI) people in the design and development of the International Crop Information System (ICIS).
I participated with Cornell University people in database structure generation and loading evaluation data from international wheat nurseries into GreenGenes World Wide Web System.
I participated with International Center for Agroforestry (ICRAF) people in database structure generation and design of logbook system that allowed handling observation variables for experiments on field.
I participated with the Australian Cereal Winter Collection people to develop the Wheat Resource Information Package version II and I (GRIP II)

positions.title: Sistems Production Manager
positions.description:
Primary responsibilities were for maintenance, installation and support of all the systems running in the enterprise, such as sales, statistical reports, bank conciliations, financial, invoice, inventory, and manufacturing systems.

Secondary responsibilities were scheduling systems production and data entry processes as well as hardware maintenance.

Originally my responsibilities were to maintain the old invoice system, analysis and development of the new one, the customer account management system, statistical sales system, manufacturing system and banking conciliation system.
